title: Jazz Limited musicians, drummers and attire

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Did he still -- was he still wearing tuxes by then, or did --
No, we didn't start wearing tuxes until we moved in the new place.
When was that?
Moved there sometime around 1960. I can't remember exactly when, because I hadn't been with the band too long.
Yeah, you were in the new place when I came to town, which was 1960's, so -- who were some of the other musicians that went through the band? In all those years you were there?
Art Hodes Miff, some other big name jazz musicians. Jack Teagarden, Mole --
They'd come down and sit in, or --
No, they were in the band a long time ago.
I mean when you were in?
No, that was before my time.
But I mean when you were in it, who were some of the musicians that came through?
Well, that was about it.
Didn't Nappy play a while?
Yeah, Nappy filled in, you know, on trumpet, when we needed a trumpet player. Filled in.
Well, Bobby Ballard came into the band.
Bobby Ballard came in later, during the later part.
When did Barnett come in?
Barrett came in when Freddie Kohlman Coleman left. Freddie Kohlman Coleman left -- I don't remember exactly when he left. It was Barrett followed Freddie Kohlman Coleman.
Freddie went back to New Orleans.
Went back to New Orleans.
Barrett's quite a fellow. He's always been the way he is now. But he is a great drummer.
Yes, he is. Great drummer.
Yeah, he and you got along very well.
Got along fine.
